test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A can do a work in 12 days and B in 16 days. They work together for 4 days, then A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A = 12 days

B = 16 days

Worked together = 4 days

**Formula used:

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Calculations:**

LCM of 12 and 16 = 48

⇒ Total work = 48 units

⇒ A’s 1 day work = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 units

⇒ B’s 1 day work = 48 ÷ 16 = 3 units

⇒ Together 1 day work = 4 + 3 = 7 units

⇒ Work done in 4 days = 7 × 4 = 28 units

⇒ Remaining work = 48 − 28 = 20 units

⇒ B alone does 3 units/day

⇒ Time = 20 ÷ 3 = 6(2)/(3) days

**∴ B will finish the work in 6(2)/(3) days.**
